service.name: Wedding music in Telluride
service.serviceType: Live music for weddings in Telluride and Mountain Village: ceremony guitarist, cocktail hour duo, band and DJ
service.description: Live wedding music in Telluride and Mountain Village: an acoustic, jazz or Spanish guitarist for a ceremony reached by gondola, a jazz or acoustic duo for a terrace cocktail hour at altitude, a band or the DJ for a reception inside the town's amplified-sound hours, on one contract with sound included, one travel line and a night's lodging at cost.

faqs.q: Do you play weddings in Telluride?
faqs.a: Yes, the whole day or any one part of it, with the fee for the music, one travel line for the drive and a night's lodging at cost on the quote. Every size arrives with sound, setup and pack-down, a certificate of insurance and a W-9. Signet Artists books Telluride weddings from Denver.

faqs.q: What are Telluride's rules on amplified music at a wedding?
faqs.a: The town's code allows amplified sound, indoors and out, from 7am to 11pm on Fridays, Saturdays and defined holidays under a permit, as long as it isn't plainly audible beyond what the permit sets. So the floor's last song lands before eleven on a Saturday. We confirm the current version with the venue before the day.

faqs.q: Can the ceremony be at San Sophia Overlook?
faqs.a: Yes. The overlook is reached by gondola, so the guitarist and a small battery-powered system ride up with the guests, and the reception happens back in Mountain Village or in town afterward. A ceremony that high is planned for the light and the cold, and the guitarist is set up and tuned well before the first guest steps off the gondola. A ceremony site with power uses the site's own circuit instead.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we book wedding musicians in Telluride?
faqs.a: As early as the venue. A Telluride venue books its summer Saturdays well over a year out, the lodging in a small town goes with it, and the musicians' night in town has to be booked as well, so the date is the first thing we need. Tell us the date and the ceremony site and we'll come back quickly with a price for the day, travel and lodging itemized.
